newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's forint trades steady vs basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's forint trades steady vs basket.

text.p: The Hungarian forint opened a little weaker against the dollar on Friday as the U.S. unit strengthened versus the mark.
The forint opened at 184.85/90 to the dollar, compared to Thursday's close of 184.50/55. At 0805 GMT it stood at 184.93/98.
In early trading market bids were on the central bank's (NBH) resistance level and dealers said the market would follow changes in dollar/mark crosses.

"We're following dollar/mark," said Balazs Benczedi of WestLB Hungaria, who predicted the forint would stay close to the NBH resistance level later in the session as commercial items come through the market.
